description.zh: 村庄中心的宁静石板广场。中央的老井仍然滴着清澈的井水，旅馆旁立着一块破旧的公告板，纸片在微风中轻轻飘动。
description.en: A peaceful cobblestone plaza lies at the heart of the village. The old well in the center still drips with fresh water. A worn notice board stands near the inn, its parchments fluttering in a gentle breeze.

dialogue.zh: 欢迎，旅行者！在这里休息，恢复你的力量。
dialogue.en: Welcome, traveler! Rest here and regain your strength.

dialogue.zh: 小心森林——边缘附近有哥布林出没。
dialogue.en: Be careful in the forest — goblins have been spotted near the edge.

dialogue.zh: 需要补给的话，东边的商店一直开着。
dialogue.en: If you need supplies, the shop to the east stays open all day.

description.zh: 一间堆满货架的狭小店铺。柜台后的店主打着瞌睡，听见脚步才抬起头来。
description.en: A cramped shop crammed with shelves. The shopkeeper behind the counter stirs at the sound of footsteps.

dialogue.zh: 客官看看，都是实惠的好货。
dialogue.en: Take a look, all good deals here.

dialogue.zh: 地牢里捡到的好东西，以后也能卖给我换金币。
dialogue.en: Found something good in the dungeon? I'll buy it off you for gold.

description.zh: 村庄北缘的迷雾森林入口。林间雾气翻涌，一块歪斜的木牌上写着「前方危险」。准备好后，从这里进入森林地牢。
description.en: The misty forest edge at the village's northern border. Fog churns between the trees; a crooked wooden sign reads “Danger ahead”. Enter the forest dungeon from here when ready.
